description: The main window's baseline capability (task 12.1). Grants only `core:default` — the permission set Tauri itself needs to create and manage a window, nothing app-specific. No command any connector or feature adds is capability-gated here; each one gets its own named permission when it's added, the same per-capability, denied-unless-explicit shape task 2.6 established on mobile (see research 0010's security-model finding).
